session_summary: The player successfully completed the Moon Shrine route, collected multiple coin drops (6, 12, and 4), successfully engaged and defeated 3 Slimes, and completed the route to earn a 25 coin bonus. The accumulated 126 coins were then used to purchase and equip the 'trail_cap' cosmetic in the marketplace.

observations.evidence: Backlog item lists 'High-Contrast UI Theme & Focus States' due to missing clear keyboard focus rings during marketplace and UI navigation.
observations.recommendation: Implement high-contrast focus rings and visible selection outlines on all interactive UI buttons and marketplace items.

observations.evidence: Marketplace purchase completed cleanly with clear text feedback ('Purchased and equipped Trail Cap for 45 coins.').
observations.recommendation: Keep the concise post-purchase messaging style for marketplace interactions.

feature_requests.title: Visible Keyboard Focus Rings and High-Contrast Theme Option
feature_requests.player_value: Improves navigation for keyboard-only and visually impaired players by making active UI elements unmistakable.
feature_requests.rationale: Currently, interface elements lack clear focus indicators, which increases cognitive load when operating the game without a mouse.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add distinct keyboard focus states and a high-contrast visual toggle in settings.

keep: Clear textual transaction feedback upon marketplace purchases
focus: readability, button clarity, cognitive load, feedback, keyboard/mouse usability
